ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to show nearby loads, repair shops, fuel stations and truck stops on the map and in the AI assistant, and to share your position in chats or SOS. During an active trip your route is also recorded in the background and shown to the cargo owner and dispatcher; recording stops when the trip is closed or when you stop it.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to take photos of documents, receipts, cargo and vehicles, and to scan documents. Scanned documents are sent to an AI service to read the text.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to choose photos of documents, receipts and listings from your library. Only the photos you pick are accessed.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used to record voice messages in chats and to describe a problem to a mechanic by voice. Recordings may be sent to an AI service to convert them to text.
